title: FAITH AND ENCOURAGEMENT

blocks.text: “The world is entering a stage where it cannot cope with all its problems. This earth is very perilous; the times are uncertain to its leaders! – The nations are in perplexity! So, at some point, they will make the wrong choice in leadership, simply because they do not know what the future holds! . . . But we that have and love the Lord know what is ahead! And He definitely will guide us through any turbulence, uncertainty or problems!”

“In this special writing we will build faith and give encouragement for every facet of your life! Although His children are tested as they prove their faith, they are also rewarded! – The Lord is kind to those who stand firm and believe His Word. And He is full of compassion!” – Ps. 103:8, 11, “The Lord is merciful and gracious and slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear Him!” – If His children make a mistake he is helpful and merciful to forgive! – Micah 7:18, “Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity . . . because he delighteth in mercy!” – If Satan tries to condemn you for something you said, or something that is not pleasing in the Lord’s eyes, one should just simply accept God’s forgiveness and the Lord will help you to grow stronger! . . . and your faith will increase and pull you out of any problems you are confronted with! When people do this, we see tremendous miracles take place! – “The Lord Jesus has never failed an honest heart who loves Him! And He will never fail those that love His Word and expect His coming!”

“He is a God of miracles and wonders!” As the Bible says, “There is nothing too hard for the Lord to do for each individual!” – In fact, Jesus said, “All things are possible to those who act upon their faith and His promises!” And the more that you practice your faith in strong determination and no matter what the devil or negative forces tell you, your faith will absolutely grow greater! – You will become more confident and sure of yourself!

“There is a powerful anointing on this special writing and it will increase your trust in His promises in the time of need! If you love His promises and this writing, then you know you are a child of the Lord! And He has promised to guide in these last days. He will not fail, but He will certainly see you through, and stand with you all the way. Jesus is your shield, your friend and Saviour! Many things will be confronting this nation and its people, but the promises of God are sure, and He will not forget those who have not forgotten Him and those who are helping in His harvest work!”

“Let’s not forget all of His benefits. The Lord has promised to give healing, divine health; even to renew the older body, and extend it into long life!” (Read Ps. 103:2-5) – “As we see in these following Scriptures the Lord says, take no thought or worry about the things that you need, just accept His promises by faith, He will supply whatever it is you need! – The Lord says He feeds the fowls of the air. And the lilies of the field, they grow and toil not. And the Lord says, Are ye not much better than these?” (Read Matt. 6:26-33) – “He cares for you and will safely see you through any situation and will provide daily for you!” – Jesus said, “Fear and worry will not change any problem; and not to let the future trouble you. But on the other hand, He says faith will change things for you, and give you insight!” (Matt. 6:34, and read vrs. 27-28)

Concerning healing and miracles, Jesus said to the Syrophenician woman, “O great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt!” (Matt. 15:28) – Unlimited power! To the leper, “Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.” (Luke 17:19) – “You have the seed of faith in you. Turn it loose!” – To the woman who was a sinner, Jesus said, “Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace!” (Luke 7:50) – To the centurion, Jesus said, “Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee!” (Matt. 8:13) – In another place He said, “Daughter, be of good comfort, thy faith hath made thee whole!” – To Jairus, whose daughter passed away, He said, “Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.” (Luke 8:50) “And that is exactly what occurred. Praise Him!”

“So we see by faith all things are possible, and nothing shall be impossible!” (Mark 9:23) – “One’s faith can grow so powerful that a mountain can actually be removed!” (Mark 11:22-23) – “Jesus challenges us to believe; and says by faith, what things so ever you desire, when you pray, believing you may have!” (Mark 11:24) – “So we see these promises are for us the believer! And believe me, we see them occur often and in our daily mail, miracles are wrought! Jesus is ready to meet any need you have.” – Here are some Scriptures of encouragement concerning prosperity. – Mal. 3:10, “Prove me now, saith the Lord. And it says, He will pour out a blessing unto you! . . . The Lord shall make thee plenteous in goods. (Deut. 28:11) – Give and thou shalt have treasures in heaven!” (Matt. 19:21) – “There is not a bank in this whole world that can give you the dividends back on your money like the Lord does! – Not only blesses you in this world (materially) but in the spiritual world, eternal life to come! . . . So we see the Lord’s Word is packed full of goodness and miracles of all sorts!” And He says, “Only believe, and you can have whatsoever you saith!” (Mark 11:22-23)
